column3: With respect to the 32 Old Slip - Leased Fee Mortgage Loan (1.5%), certain fire code, housing and preservation and building department violations are open at the Mortgaged Property. The Mortgage Loan documents require the borrowers to use commercially reasonable efforts to cause the related ground tenant to promptly pay, satisfy or otherwise fully discharge such violations.
